lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice får plus infinitive for permission and friendly offers.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Small practical interactions in the office kitchen.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Asking permission and giving permission politely.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik are in the office kitchen. They ask if they may take a cup, borrow something, or take a snack, and answer politely.

main_focus.name: får plus infinitive for permission
main_focus.description: Use får before an infinitive to ask for or give permission in everyday situations.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use får plus infinitive naturally 4-5 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use permission phrases with concrete office and fika objects.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks permission to take or use something.
dialogue_shape.middle: They handle two small permission exchanges with friendly responses.
dialogue_shape.ending: They thank each other and continue the break.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat får in both questions and permission-giving statements

focus: what object one speaker asks to take or borrow

sentence_focus: one question beginning with får jag
one sentence giving permission with du får
one sentence about borrowing an object
